title: CLAUDE.md
text: R/utils-api.R single chokepoint network /O: pga_graphql_request(operation_name, variables) — POSTs https://orchestrator.pgatour.com/graphql, loads query text inst/graphql/<operation_name>.graphql, sends x-api-key header, throttles 10 req/sec via req_throttle, applies req_timeout(30) + req_retry(max_tries = 3) 408/429/5xx, returns data field. GraphQL errors HTTP ≥400 abort cli_abort. Non-JSON 200 responses caught surfaced via pga_parse_json(). pga_rest_request(path) — GETs https://data-api.pgatour.com/<path>, throttling + timeout + retry, returns parsed JSON. pga_config_request(path) — GETs https://orchestrator-config.pgatour.com/<path> (default tournaments, seasons). retry policy. Query strings cached .pga_cache environment, keyed operation name, .graphql file read disk per session. x-api-key public key embedded PGA Tour frontend. bundled default lives .pga_api_key_default; pga_api_key() prefers PGA_API_KEY env var users can swap keys without reinstalling frontend key rotates. Every user-facing pga_*() function R/ thin wrapper: call pga_graphql_request / pga_rest_request, shape result tibble. Add new endpoints dropping .graphql file inst/graphql/ whose stem matches operationName, calling pga_graphql_request("YourOpName", list(...)). Mocking depends call going two transports — anything bypasses hard test.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Several GraphQL operations (ending Compressed, e.g. LeaderboardCompressedV3, ScorecardCompressedV3, shotDetailsV4Compressed, TeeTimesCompressedV2, CurrentLeadersCompressed, oddsToWinCompressed, GenericContentCompressed) return payload string base64-encoded gzip JSON. Pass pga_decompress() R/utils-decompress.R parsing. pga_decompress: Validates input (must non-empty character scalar) wraps step (base64 → gunzip → JSON parse) tryCatch re-throws clear, named error instead cryptic C-level inflateEnd message. Uses jsonlite::fromJSON(..., simplifyVector = TRUE), parsed$players etc. come back data.frame/matrix, list--lists. Flattening code (see R/leaderboard.R) depends shape. top-level field comes back empty list (e.g. parsed$holes = list() shot data exists), guards must check .data.frame() length() calling nrow() — see R/shot_details.R:36–39 pattern.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: R/utils-parse.R: - to_snake_case() / clean_names() — convert API camelCase snake_case columns. - make_unique_snake(x) — sanitize free-form labels (spaces/punctuation) unique snake_case column names. Uses make.unique() duplicate API headers don’t collide. Use whenever building columns dynamic API header strings (StatDetails$statHeaders, pga_player_results header labels, etc.). - validate_tour_code() — "R" (PGA), "S" (Champions), "H" (Korn Ferry), "Y" (Americas) valid. - safe_pluck(x, ...) — nested list access returns NULL instead erroring; used heavily reshaping heterogeneous API responses. Row-binding uses vctrs::vec_rbind() (.call(rbind, ...)) heterogeneous columns across chunks get filled NA instead erroring. vec_cbind() equivalent column binding. %||% (base R 4.4+, package Depends: R (>= 4.1.0)) used throughout — ’s unavailable minimum R version, surface check failure.

title: Getting Started with pgatouR
text: week’s ID: pga_current_tournament() source live site uses. Pass "S", "H", "Y" tours. Rate limiting built 10 requests/second. don’t need add delays. Compressed payloads (leaderboards, scorecards, tee times, shot details, odds, scatter, scorecard stats) decompressed automatically. always get clean tibble. Error messages use cli package tell exactly went wrong (bad tournament ID, API errors, etc.). stat_ids lazy-loaded — just type stat_ids access , data() call needed. Use pga_stat_catalog() want live hub instead bundled snapshot. @return section function’s help page (?pga_leaderboard) describes exact columns ’ll get back.

title: R Client for the PGA Tour API
text: stat_ids dataset covers 470+ stats across categories: Strokes Gained — Total, Tee--Green, --Tee, Approach, Around--Green, Putting Tee — Driving distance, accuracy, ball speed, club head speed, launch angle, spin rate Approach Green — GIR, proximity hole (distance bucket, fairway/rough), going Around Green — Scrambling, sand saves, proximity (distance lie) Putting — Putting average, putts per round, make rates distance (3’ 25’+), GIR putting Scoring — Scoring average, birdies, eagles, bogey avoidance, par 3/4/5 scoring, round, front/back 9 Streaks — Consecutive cuts, fairways, GIR, birdies, rounds 60s Money/Finishes — Official money, career earnings, top 10s, victories Points/Rankings — FedExCup, world ranking, power/accuracy/putting ratings

title: R Client for the PGA Tour API
text: package wraps PGA Tour’s GraphQL REST APIs: GraphQL endpoint: https://orchestrator.pgatour.com/graphql REST endpoint: https://data-api.pgatour.com Authentication: Uses public API key embedded PGA Tour frontend (user authentication required). frontend key rotates, set Sys.setenv(PGA_API_KEY = "...") override bundled default without reinstalling. Rate limiting: Built-throttling 10 requests/second. Resilience: 30-second timeout, 3-try retry transient failures (408 / 429 / 5xx), clear error messages API returns malformed responses. Several endpoints return gzip+base64 compressed payloads. package handles decompression transparently.

title: pgatouR 0.3.0
text: Tour code "Y" (PGA Tour Americas) now first-class tour alongside "R", "S", "H". pga_current_tournament() returns site’s featured event tour (orchestrator-config web-config). New tournament wrappers: pga_field(), pga_field_stats(), pga_tournament_overview(), pga_tournament_past_results(), pga_weather(), pga_course_stats(), pga_course_stats_overview(), pga_hole_details(), pga_leaderboard_holes(), pga_leaderboard_strokes(), pga_leaderboard_stats(), pga_group_locations(), pga_shot_scatter(), pga_scorecard_stats(). New standings wrappers: pga_signature_standings(), pga_priority_rankings(), pga_cup_standings(), pga_bubble(), pga_university_rankings(), pga_all_time_record_categories(), pga_all_time_records(). New stats helpers: pga_stat_catalog(), pga_stat_leaders(), pga_player_finish_stats(). Odds: pga_odds_markets() (market catalog) pga_odds_player() (per-player lines). pga_odds() remains outright--win. pga_leaderboard() now also returns tee time, course, group, movement, total strokes, amateur flag, official/projected cup ranks. pga_fedex_cup() uses correct cup stat ID per tour (FedExCup, Schwab, Fortinet, Americas points).

title: pgatouR 0.3.0
text: Offline fixtures recaptured new operations. API reference last checked 2026-08-15 frontend pgatour-prod-2.29.2.

title: pgatouR 0.2.0
text: pga_player_tournament_status() now returns zero-row tibble API status report (player currently tournament). previously returned one-row tibble NA columns. column schema unchanged. pga_stats() longer attaches metadata (stat_title, tour_avg, year, display_season) attributes. stat_title, stat_id, year now real columns returned tibble; metadata dropped (silently lost moment dplyr verb ran result anyway).

title: pgatouR 0.2.0
text: pga_stats() accepts vectors stat_id year, looping internally stacking results stat_id year columns. pga_stats() pga_fedex_cup() gain event_query argument passes upstream StatDetailEventQuery variable. Three new endpoints fill documented API coverage: pga_content() (CMS content), pga_odds_interactivity() (odds widget config), pga_speed_rounds() (speed-rounds video index). PGA_API_KEY env var overrides bundled frontend key users can swap keys without reinstalling public key rotates. PGATOUR_VERBOSE env var enables request-level logging via cli troubleshooting.

title: pgatouR 0.2.0
text: pga_player_tournament_status(): fixed phantom roundDisplay mapping always NA. fields actually returned API (roundStatusDisplay, roundStatusColor) now surfaced columns. pga_player_results(): hardcoding first season response, silently dropping seasons. Now returns every season season column. pga_player_stats(): rank now integer column rather character. pga_shot_details(): longer crashes “missing value TRUE/FALSE needed” API returns empty holes list (e.g. player tracked shots round). pga_decompress(): malformed payloads (empty string, non-base64, invalid gzip, invalid JSON) now produce clear errors naming failed step instead cryptic C-level messages like inflateEnd -3. Header-derived column names previously collided (e.g. two "Rank" labels player results, free-form spaces stat headers) now deduplicated via make_unique_snake().

title: pgatouR 0.2.0
text: Transport now applies 30-second req_timeout() three-try req_retry() 408/429/5xx, transient CDN failures recover automatically instead failing call. Non-JSON 200 responses caught surfaced operation name status code, instead crashing resp_body_json(). pga_tee_times() now builds one tibble per group rather per player, drastically reducing allocations large fields. pga_leaderboard() now %||%-guards every player/scoring field partial response API can’t break tibble construction. total_sort score_sort returned numeric (character). pga_tournaments() uses vctrs::vec_rbind() courses list-column heterogeneous course schemas longer silently fall back empty tibble.

title: pgatouR 0.2.0
text: Added offline test suite (89 tests across 10 files) mocks pga_graphql_request / pga_rest_request fixtures captured tests/testthat/fixtures/. Re-capture Rscript data-raw/fixtures.R. Added R-CMD-check GitHub Actions workflow runs macOS Ubuntu R release, devel, oldrel-1. R/utils-parse.R defines %||% locally package works R versions older 4.4 (%||% landed base). long-form guide moved CRAN-style vignette pkgdown article vignettes/articles/. R CMD check longer tangles runs live API calls.
